title: Village Residential Street Scene
description: One static residential street scene, zero new standalone models. Four fixed exterior porch cottages face a nine-tile soil lane, with 2mm real road seams, straight members from the narrow stone border kit, eight detached complete fence panels and two orchard trees. Unit-scale original geometry and full solid PBR are preserved. Border corner member is not included. Requires external flat Z0 ground. Original door leaves remain fixed; no enterable interior, navigation, collision-controller, accessibility or building safety certification.
